{{Top|leg}}
'''Hemocyanin''' was the component of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]] that made it blue-green.<ref name="CNJT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'' 280.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, hemocyanin is found in the blood of most [[Wikipedia:mollusca|mollusks]] and some [[Wikipedia:arthropod|arthropods]], like the [[Wikipedia:horseshoe crab|horseshoe crab]].

*''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''
